_comment: VFX keyframes for Spirits Calling. Pure BLACK background so the frame reads as an additive/emissive element. Feed each PNG into a ComfyUI video model (LTX-2.3 / Wan 2.2 image-to-video) to animate, then extract frames -> sprite sheet -> UE Niagara SubUV. Keep colors bright and the background solid black.

defaults.negative: background, scenery, landscape, room, floor, character, face, text, watermark, gray background, white background, low contrast
